newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVENSKE ELEKTRARNE TO SIGN 70 MLN EIB LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENSKE ELEKTRARNE TO SIGN 70 MLN EIB LOAN.

text.p: Slovenske Elektrarne a.s. (SE), the Slovak state monopoly electricity utility, said on Wednesday it will sign a 15-year, 70 million ECU loan with the European Investment Bank (EIB).
"The price of this loan, which will be signed on Friday, will include coverage of EIB costs for obtaining the funds for the credit," SE financial director Anton Masar told Reuters.
Masar said further details on the facility will be released later this week.

The SE made its international market debut earlier this year with a $150 million, three-year syndicated loan at 0.875 percentage points above LIBOR, lead managed by J.P.Morgan Securities Ltd. -- Peter Javurek, Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-563-3687
